title: Polynomial interpolation on a subset
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, and let $v:\iota\to F$ be injective on a finite set $s\subseteq\iota$. For every finite set $t\subseteq s$ and every function $w:\iota\to F$, there is a polynomial $p\in F[X]$ of degree less than $|s|$ such that $p(v(i))=w(i)$ for every $i\in t$.
